text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh? Go to an amusement park together?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Right now, Maya is putting together 
an amusement park date plan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And so, I really want you to come along to 
scout it out with me, Laurel-san! I'd love 
to get some mature advice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, if I'll do, I'd be delighted♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This attraction is super popular right 
now! Maya definitely wants it in the 
plan~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but it's a one-hour wait. Standing 
in line might be tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even waiting in line can be turned into an 
exciting date if you get a little 
creative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Like playing word games, taking 
personality quizzes... Or in my case, I 
have some amusing little French anecdotes 
to share.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! That sounds like such a grown-up 
technique! Teach me, teach me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
These pancakes are so yuuuummy~♪ No wonder 
they're the park's most popular item☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Though it might be a bit too heavy for 
a date.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about the soufflé I 
ordered? It's a modest portion and 
deliciously fluffy♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?! Hey, hey, can I have a bite?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, that ride from earlier is empty 
now. We could get on right away at this 
hour.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see! If we save this for later, we can 
ride way more things! Gotta remember 
that~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for today, Laurel-san! 
Thanks to you, this is gonna be a great 
plan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome♪ By the way, 
Maya-chan, who are you planning to invite 
with this itinerary?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ The one I wanna invite is~~~~... 
—Maya's Papa!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
He might be getting some time off soon! So 
I really wanna make it exciting for him~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With the ab-so-lute best date plan created 
by Maya!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel, Maya-chan...! 
Je ne pense qu'à toi chaque jour!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...? Juh... paw ska...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's my father's favorite phrase♪ I'm sure 
your father will say the same and be 
overjoyed. I'm rooting for your date!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy, Mayano 
Top Gun called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san, you gave me advice 
before! Can I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You see, Maya came up with amusement park 
date plans! But I ended up with two, so I 
wanted to ask which one you think is 
better!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One is a chill sightseeing plan hitting 
shops and photo spots! The other is an 
action-packed play plan centered around 
rides!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, which one sounds better?
choice_data_list: The action-packed play plan sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~! Adults prefer taking their time to 
look around leisurely~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! That helps a ton! I hope he enjoys 
it~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she said that, Mayano Top Gun looked 
utterly thrilled, daydreaming about the 
date.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Getting to play as much as 
possible is way more fun~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! That was super helpful! Mfufu~ I'm 
getting more and more excited!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Papa~! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next up is that attraction! At this hour, 
we can hop right on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya put together a plan with tons of 
playtime! Let's play non-stop all day 
long!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Mayano Top Gun happily reported 
back, saying, 'It was such a fun date!'
